topic: How celestial objects affect human activities
key_concepts: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.

The Moon influences cultural celebrations and sea-related activities.
Chinese New Year begins on a new moon day.
The Moon causes ocean tides, which can be used to generate electricity.
Stars are easier to see at night because the sky is dark.
The North Star helps people find north.
Fishermen use stars to navigate at sea.
